description: This file defines the 'NoteEditorView' SwiftUI view for editing and deleting notes within the Note Organizer iOS application. It includes UI components such as text fields, text editors, and buttons, and manages user interactions like saving and deleting notes with confirmation alerts.

classes.name: NoteEditorView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that provides a user interface for editing note title and content, with options to save or delete the note.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Constructs the SwiftUI view hierarchy, managing the layout, UI controls, and user interaction logic for note editing.
